tasks.title: Plan a routine maintenance task
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the job information, identify the property/task and explain the sequence you will follow.

tasks.title: Use technical information to solve a maintenance problem
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the specification, drawing, job sheet, manual or digital information used and explain how it informed the work.

tasks.title: Assess risks and set up a safe work area
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the work area, hazards, controls, access arrangements and protection used before starting.

tasks.title: Select and use tools and equipment safely
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the hand or power tools selected, safety checks, safeguards and correct use.

tasks.title: Select compliant materials and components
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the materials/components and the specification or regulatory information used to confirm suitability.

tasks.title: Inspect completed work and close the job
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show the finished work, the checks against the job requirement and any correction made before completion.

tasks.title: Reduce waste and segregate resources
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Show how waste, reusable material and recyclable material are separated and explain the environmental requirements.

tasks.title: Improve energy and environmental performance
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Use a real maintenance example to explain how the task can reduce energy use, waste or environmental impact.

tasks.title: Communicate with customers and the maintenance team
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Give a real example of communicating with a customer, colleague or specialist trade and explain the information shared and outcome.

tasks.title: Recognise limits and escalate work safely
tasks.conditionalPrompt: Describe a real situation where the work reached your competence or authority limit, what you did and who you escalated it to.
